name: ai-academy
description: AI Orchestration Mastery - CRM built across a 5-day course

scripts.setup: bash scripts/preflight.sh && npm run db:up && npm run db:migrate
scripts.dev: concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run --workspace apps/api build && npm run --workspace apps/web build
scripts.db:reset: docker compose --env-file .env.local down -v && npm run db:up && npm run db:migrate
